label: latency
question: How many Sundays per year must an employee have off?

final.answer: Under the ArbZG § 11 para. 1, at least 15 Sundays per year must remain free of work (beschäftigungsfrei) for each employee. Exceptions apply only in certain sectors under § 12, which lowers the minimum for those establishments.
